title.narrative: Local Partnerships for energy efficiency in social services

description.narrative:
The Action intends to achieve three main outcomes: (1) Strong partnerships built between CSOs and PAs for the development and implementation of energy efficiency measures;

(2) Community-based services provided in nearly zero-emission buildings increase the resilience of service providers towards energy crisis; (3) Local communities are aware and adopt responsible behaviour towards energy transition.
